# The New Age Parents

> > A Singapore-based parenting magazine offering practical guides, educational resources, and community support for modern families.

The New Age Parents Online Magazine serves Singapore families with articles on child development, education (including Montessori Method), activities, and parenting support. The site connects parents with local resources, preschool reviews, and community groups.

## Key Topics

- Singapore parenting
- Montessori Method
- Preschool education
- Child development
- Parenting support groups
- Family activities
- Baking with children
- Guide Dogs Singapore
- Wharton Preschool
- Community volunteering
- Educational curriculum
- Singapore education system
- Parent resources

## Parenting Support & Community

- [Online Parenting Support Groups](https://thenewageparents.com/online-parenting-support-groups/): Directory of Facebook parenting support groups for Singapore parents

## Education & Preschool Resources

- [Wharton Preschool: Preparing Your Child For School And Life](https://thenewageparents.com/wharton-preschool-preparing-your-child-for-school-and-life/): Review of Wharton Preschool's Montessori Method curriculum in Ang Mo Kio

## Activities & Practical Guides

- [Baking With Your Child: A Practical Step By Step Guide](https://thenewageparents.com/baking-with-your-child/): Step-by-step guide with practical tips for baking activities with kids

## Community & Events

- [Volunteer For International Guide Dog Day 2020](https://thenewageparents.com/international-guide-dog-day/): Guide Dogs Singapore volunteer opportunity for IGDD 2020 fundraising event

## Optional

- [Welcome to The New Age Parents!](https://thenewageparents.com/welcome-to-new-age-parents/): Subscription confirmation page for The New Age Parents Online Magazine
